task.title: Port trade history pricing
task.description:
## Why
The League trades view prices each past trade at the values of its week and at today's, and names who won.

## Steps
1. Port `rebuild/trade_history.py`: `build`, `managers`, `market`, `snapshot_for` and the draft-slot helpers.
2. Take the list of value snapshots and their contents as inputs. Fetching them belongs to the data layer.
3. Keep the rule that a failure in this section does not fail the report.

## Done when
- The trade-history parity test passes for every fixture.
